name: Emoji & Icon Studio by Kairesh
releaseNotes:
v2.8.2 Drag & Drop, Real-time Folder Sync & Disk Watching!
• Native Drag & Drop: Drag any emoji, icon, or local file directly onto After Effects Composition viewer or Premiere Pro timeline!
• Real-Time Folder Sync: Adding, deleting, or renaming files in your local folder in Windows Explorer instantly updates the plugin in real-time!
• Smart Local Folder Persistence: Adding any icon from recents or library writes the real file into your selected folder so you keep your assets forever even if removed from the project!
• Dead Folder & File Pruning: If a folder or file is deleted from disk, the plugin cleanly removes it without showing broken items!
• Quick Save to Folder button (📁) on Recents cards and manual 🔄 Refresh button in Folders toolbar
